query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('clock',(SELECT event_time_utc FROM routelens_p05.namespace_clock WHERE namespace='p08-63aa6a950c794c54'),'traversals',(SELECT count(*) FROM routelens_p05.traversals WHERE namespace='p08-63aa6a950c794c54'),'publications',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) FROM (SELECT publisher_id,sequence,traffic_snapshot_id,encode(sha256(artifact),'hex') AS actual_artifact_sha256,octet_length(artifact) AS byte_length,published_at,valid_until FROM routelens_p07.publications WHERE namespace='p08-63aa6a950c794c54' ORDER BY publisher_id,sequence)p),'consumers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) FROM (SELECT consumer_id,high_water,last_snapshot_id,octet_length(artifact) AS active_byte_length FROM routelens_p07.consumer_states WHERE namespace='p08-63aa6a950c794c54' ORDER BY consumer_id)c));
message_en: Main read the exact owned P08 database during execution; counts and versions are a point-in-time observation, not final totals.
message_ko: 메인이 실행 중 정확한 소유 P08 DB를 직접 읽었습니다. 개수와 버전은 그 시점의 관측이며 최종 합계가 아닙니다.
